subject: C1 on the fixed lineup: merged, ready, nothing run (PLAN 4.4 + 16.3)
body: Lineup (PLAN 4.4, configs/models.json): dev target openai-compat:Qwen/Qwen3-30B-A3B; held-out targets anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-5+thinking and openai:gpt-5+thinking (A1 on these is a LOWER BOUND, summarized reasoning); J1 anthropic:claude-haiku-4-5, J2 openai:gpt-5.1; headline per target = cross-family judge. Merged: 0656035 (Sonnet 4.5 thinking form, prices, spend-cap tests), e46d4d6 (every judge gives A1+A2, families, headline judge, dev judge answers probes: dev sample = 12 calls with Haiku's set, was 7), 308e3e7 (empty/truncated target replies are errors; judge-only Scenario.rubric; generator prompt no longer says 'study'), 6284898 (OPENAI_COMPAT_PLAIN_THINKING for Qwen probe calls), cfc0a8c/fdbb87b/34521c6 (gate calibrates the judges; V3 decisive-pairs gap; estimates), 10dbdad (7 V3 probes). PROMPT CHANGE: generate() wording changed, so environments from earlier dry runs are not comparable with later ones. Pilot bound: 1,521 gate calls, about $14.73 API + Qwen GPU time ($33.74 with V3); full gate about $209 + GPU ($331 with V3). Nothing has been run; the pilot waits for Nathan's approval and a final prereg. Not done on purpose: rubric-to-system caching (text is 140-300 tokens, below every cache minimum). Sonnet 4.5 retires 2026-11-30.
